F2_law: a violation rate is a property of (problem, ensemble). It NEVER impersonates a worst-case charge.
design_law_1: all rates over DISTINCT m-subsets only; r, subset count and the uniform-tuple cap ship beside every rate so the deflator species cannot recur
design_law_3: optimization rows report FEASIBLE and OPTIMAL regions separately, never pooled

S1_calibration.status: THEOREM-FORCED — calibration only, sealed as such. Verifies generator, enumerator, encoding.

confound_1_forced_zero_leak.note: every decision-EASY row is a CSP carrying exactly one theorem-forced zero, which drags its mean down. S-1's calibration arm was leaking into S-2's statistic.

confound_2_region_size.note: the separation is carried by the large-r stratum and nearly vanishes in the small-r stratum

confound_3_region_kind.note: STRUCTURAL: every optimal-region row in this pilot is decision-hard and every decision-easy row is a solutions-region row. Region kind and hardness are not separable in this sample.

S4_registry.verdict: NOT FILED — no open cell was in scope; every pilot row's decision charge is already cited, so there was nothing to predict-then-fill.
